mentions.name: UIKit-based mapping app
mentions.description: A new mapping app being built primarily with UIKit, with bits of SwiftUI dropped in, a stack chosen because SwiftUI map support is virtually non-existent.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've recently plumped for UIKit (with bits of SwiftUI dropped in) for a new mapping app because, as you say, SwiftUI map support is virtually non-existent.
